تفترسون (form VIII)
# تَفْتَرِسُونَ (taftarisūna) /taf.ta.ri.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَرَسَ (iftarasa)
# تُفْتَرَسُونَ (tuftarasūna) /tuf.ta.ra.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَرَسَ (iftarasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
